environment.description: EC2 c5.xlarge instance running the Flask monolith with Gunicorn (4 workers, 8 threads each) behind an ALB. PostgreSQL 13 on RDS with RLS policies on the documents table using app.current_tenant session variable. The RLS policy is: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::int). However, the UPDATE statement in the transfer endpoint bypasses RLS because the app_user role has the BYPASSRLS attribute granted during initial provisioning for migration scripts. The ThreadedConnectionPool shares connections across threads within the same worker, creating a TOCTOU race where concurrent requests can corrupt the session tenant context between the ownership check SELECT and the UPDATE.
